description: Changes the app's media: content managed from the panel (a gallery, a catalogue, files for sale) in collections. Files the code loads by path go to neblla_upload_file; both spend the same storage. Changes are live at once in pre and pro: no save, no versions. upload {collection, items} (up to 50; a collection is created when first named; big originals are kept unless resize), update, move, reorder, delete, shrink (replaces originals), create / rename / delete collections, private {ids | collection, private} (the original is never public) and link / unlink {productId, ids | collection}: a product unlocks them (owner only). More: neblla_get_llms tools/media

action.description: What to do. By action: shrink {ids | collection, maxSide?, dryRun?}; update {id, title?, text?, alt?, note?, fields?, replaceFields?}; move {ids, collection, position?}; reorder {collection, ids}; delete {ids}; create_collection {collection}; rename_collection {collection, newName}; delete_collection {collection, withItems?}…

alt.description: update: the image's alternative text; null removes it.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

collection.description: The collection, by name ("Weddings") or key.

confirm.description: delete, delete_collection, shrink: true runs it (it cannot be undone); without it the answer says what would be lost.

dryRun.description: shrink: say what it would save, change nothing.

fields.description: update: merged into the card; null removes a field.

ids.description: move, reorder, delete, shrink, private, link, unlink: the items.

items.description: upload: [{ contentUrl | content, title?, text?, alt?, fields? }], up to 50.

maxSide.description: shrink: the long side to reduce to (default 2560).

note.description: update: a note for the developer's AI, never shown to users; null removes it.

position.description: upload / move: at the end (default) or the start.

private.description: private / upload: the original is private, unlocked by a purchase.

productId.description: link / unlink: a one_time product or subscription that unlocks it.

publicWidth.description: private / upload: the widest variant the public sees.

replaceFields.description: update: the fields given replace all of them.

resize.description: upload: true reduces images bigger than a screen needs; a number, to that long side.

text.description: update: the card's text; null removes it.

title.description: update: the card's title; null removes it.

name: neblla_media
title: Manage media
